method: atomscan slow scans and cleave facts for each original file
Rizin analysis and Capstone disassembly; no specimen launched as a host process
Unicorn executed the Go arithmetic decoder with allocation/printing stubs; recovered native PE analyzed separately
Native payload emulation used simulated Windows APIs; configured endpoints were never contacted

evidence: VA 0x403900 checks HTTP 200; 0x40393e validates the response header; 0x4039c5 dispatches task IDs 1000 through 1019.

0x403a51 passes the received task body at packet+0x20 to 0x403466. CreatePipe at 0x4034b2, inherited stdout/stderr handles in STARTUPINFOW, and CreateProcessW at 0x4034f9 capture the command result. 0x403574 checks the pipe, 0x4035d0 reads it, and 0x403c43 packages a reply.
0x40317d obtains its own path, constructs cmd /c ping 127.0.0.1 -n 1&del "%s" on the stack, formats it with that path, and calls WinExec at 0x40324e. One loopback ping does not establish a delay.
VERSIONINFO claims Microsoft Corp. and Microsoft Word, despite the remote task handlers and self-deletion.
samples.context_limit: No installation or authorization context was supplied. Hidden command tasking and false Office identity tip the verdict; there is no evidence here of WannaCry or ransomware.

samples.identification: Obfuscated Go manual PE loader with PEB image substitution
evidence: Go 1.23.1, module TitanSignalStudios. Its self-issued signer cryptography verifies, but the Authenticode image digest does not match. This is supporting provenance evidence, not the basis of the verdict.

main.umKd2BcY at 0x50df40 reconstructs a 1,385,825-byte PE. Three in-place passes subtract 31*i+3, subtract 13*i-91, then subtract 7*i-46, modulo 256. Offline decoder emulation recovers an x64 image with entry RVA 0x21480 and image base 0x170000000.

main.je23ac4a validates MZ and PE headers. main.main obtains executable reserve/commit memory through the VirtualAlloc wrapper at 0x4b2900, copies the image, and invokes import/relocation/TLS helpers.
main.avro4 follows the current thread information through TEB+0x60 to PEB, then replaces PEB+0x10 with the mapped image base. The pointer-write observation begins at 0x4c808f.

0x4b6361 loads the parsed image's entry-point field at +0x10; 0x4b6411 adds the mapped base. The sum reaches syscall.SyscallN at 0x4b6649. Register-held arithmetic across junk initialization caused the earlier handoff matcher to miss this build.

The reconstructed native image walks loader/export structures and uses a custom name hash: seed 0x102b36fb, update (h XOR byte)*0x01000387 mod 2^32. Verified constants resolve kernel32.dll, ntdll.dll, GetProcAddress, LoadLibraryA and native memory/process APIs.

Offline native execution reconstructs a direct HTTPS IP, Telegram URL, Steam profile URL, browser user-agent strings, and a WinHTTP request/reply workflow. The live server's instructions and any downstream collection were not observed.
The 87 MB mostly random overlay is not the decoded PE source. A short Kiro string and four-byte gzip prefix in that overlay were accidental matches.
samples.context_limit: No legitimate application distribution or authorized loader deployment was established. Encoded image activation and PEB image substitution tip the verdict. A CAPE Vidar signature is only a lead; family identity and credential theft were not established.

samples.identification: PStore credential stealer and autorun worm
evidence: The UPX-labeled image contains accessible native code and resolved-address tables, with low-entropy populated UPX0. upx -t refuses the modified image; section labels alone do not prove intact compression.
0x428653 XOR-decodes strings with a supplied key. Key 2 recovers pstorec.dll, autorun directives, Winlogon paths and registry commands; key 6 recovers the executable file-association key.

0x42a4d4 loads XOR-decoded pstorec.dll, resolves PStoreCreateInstance and enumerates types/subtypes/items through COM. ReadItem wrappers produce account/password material, then 0x42a48e formats credential reports into the shared report buffer.
The HTTP sender formats POST %s HTTP/1.1 with URL-encoded form content, measures the same request buffer, and passes it to a socket-send wrapper. The credential report and POST path are both present.

Drive traversal, current-image lookup, CopyFileA resolution and writes of [autorun] plus ShellExecute=autorun.exe implement drive propagation. Relevant autorun setup appears around 0x42a235 through 0x42a394.
0x428aad builds an executable association wrapper using the existing "%1" %* command and an XOR-decoded exefile shell-open key; this hijacks ordinary executable launches.
Virtual PC opcode and VMware port 0x5658 probes gate early return.
samples.context_limit: No password-recovery or administration workflow explains concurrent password reporting, autorun self-propagation and executable-association hijacking. No ransomware behavior was identified.

changes: Removed two hostile signed-overlay composites whose required evidence did not establish staging or execution.
Extended existing RWX-call and computed-entry instruction matchers; reused the canonical unpacking and PEB-substitution objectives.
Moved gzip header presence to binary-overlay metadata and required a complete fixed header prefix.
Required an executable/CLI spelling for the short Kiro reference.
Removed unsupported ping-delay wording and renamed its canonical IDs and live consumers.
Added compiled Go SHA-1 spelling to the existing digest matcher.
Made Microsoft company-field wording describe Corp/Corporation claims and anchored the field matcher.

verification.role_removal_controls: testdata/native-loader-reasoned-review/check.py: 5 primitive controls and removal of decoder, entry handoff, and image-base write
verification.results: All 23 controls passed. Final original-file scans retain 2, 2, and 4 hostile traits respectively; short-name and gzip collisions are absent; compiled Go SHA-1 is notable.

consumer_audit: All live YAML references to renamed ping IDs were updated. The gzip aggregate references the relocated metadata atom explicitly, retaining aggregate membership for ancestor selectors while correcting header precision. The removed signature composites had no external YAML consumers. The established manual-unpacking and PEB-substitution composites supply behavioral coverage; no sample or signer exception was added.
